The background shows a warmly lit café interior with bokeh lights, wooden shelves, and blurred patrons. Golden warm lighting creates an intimate atmosphere. The couple continues their intimate café conversation, both smiling and looking downward at their drinks. The man raises his cup slightly while the woman's hands rest near her dark coffee mug on the table. Her eyes are closed in a genuine smile.
